text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Mind if I stop by the 
florist?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
My older little sister is in a recital 
soon. So I was thinking of getting her a 
bouquet.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's fine.
Yeah, that's fine with me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...! All these flowers are so pretty, 
it's hard to choose...
choice_data_list: Your little sister does ballet, right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That kid has real talent for ballet. 
She got chosen for the lead role and is 
super fired up.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: That's why I just wanted to cheer them on!
choice_data_list: You look happy.
You look happy.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... You think so?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
My parents both worked, so I looked after 
my two younger sisters. Guess you could 
call it parental instinct.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation gave an embarrassed chuckle. 
From her expression, it was plain to see 
just how much she cherished her little 
sisters.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what kind of flowers would be 
best. Should I go colorful, or paint it 
boldly in a single shade...? Hmmm."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A poster on the shop catches my eye. It 
seems their partner flower arrangement 
class is holding a one-time workshop.
choice_data_list: How about making that?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Handmade flower arrangements, huh? Hmm, 
looks like I can jump right in and join.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —Yeah! I'll go with that idea!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Joining the flower arrangement class right 
away. It seems this session's project is 
making a garland of dried flowers.

text_block_list.name: Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
A garland refers to a decorative wreath 
made by stringing together flowers, 
branches, and leaves, but originally, the 
word referred to a floral crown given as a 
token of victory.
choice_data_list: It's the perfect gift of support.
It's the perfect gift of support!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I checked with my dad, and he said 
it's totally fine to decorate the green 
room at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna put up homemade garlands to 
surprise my little sister!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
――...I see. So you make a mini bouquet 
like this and hang it with string, right?

text_block_list.name: Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
My, how skillful! It turned out just like 
the example.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that came out great!
Yeah, that turned out really well!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... You think so?

text_block_list.name: Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how about adding some of your 
own flair from here? Please choose 
whatever flowers you like and make a 
bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...! O-Originality, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
Um... this is... certainly unique, isn't 
it? T-The richly colorful combination is 
rather eccentric, shall we say...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"No... it's just pure hostility, sir... 
There isn't even a shred of encouragement 
in the air..."

text_block_list.name: Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
In your case, Shion-san, making a bouquet 
with just one kind of flower instead of a 
mix might leave less room for mistakes.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A single flower? In that case, what would 
be best...?
choice_data_list:
How about trying to think of it as a 
message?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: A message? A message... words...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Sensei! Could you tell me the 
language of flowers?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—I went with Win Variation 
to watch her younger sister's big moment.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Eldest Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Ah! Big sister!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I saw you out there stealing the spotlight 
today. You looked so cool!

text_block_list.name: Shion's Eldest Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks! But you know, I was only 
able to do my best thanks to you, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Shion's Eldest Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
You made the garland in the waiting room, 
didn't you, big sis? The delphinium 
flowers. In the language of flowers, they 
mean—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"‘You scatter happiness wherever you go.’ 
I figured that's the perfect mindset for a 
leading lady shining on stage."

text_block_list.name: Shion's Eldest Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much. My little 
sister was delighted with that garland.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: This is all thanks to your advice!
choice_data_list:
If you don't mind it being me, I'll listen 
to anything you need to talk about!

If you're okay with me, I'm here for 
you—talk to me about anything!

Your big-sister vibes really got through 
to them.

Your big sister energy really came 
through.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: This is all thanks to your advice!
choice_data_list:
If you don't mind it being me, I'll listen 
to anything you need to talk about!

If you're okay with me, I'm here for 
you—talk to me about anything!

Your big-sister vibes really got through 
to them.

Your big sister energy really came 
through.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Anything at all?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Well then... a-actually...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
About the garland, my younger sister 
begged me, 'Please make one for me 
too!'...
choice_data_list: Then shall we go make some together again?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: For real? That's a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Big sisterly charm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Spares no effort for the sake of her 
little sister. That is simply who Win 
Variation is—"
choice_data_list:
I think she's a really wonderful big 
sister.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, no, it's not that big of a 
deal...! Th-That's so embarrassing~...!
